criteria.label: Active interaction
criteria.statement: The paper concerns play or active interaction involving human participants. Interaction can qualify even when it is not called play or a game.

criteria.label: Focus
criteria.statement: The experience challenges human centrality or it meaningfully engages with nature, non-human entities, or environmental action.

criteria.label: Digital Medium
criteria.statement: The play or interaction has a digital component. Purely physical play without a digital counterpart does not qualify.
